voice_rules: Put the answer in the first line.
No hype words and no numbers without a source.
Claim only what was seen working in the product (see facts).
End with a question when it fits.

F1.text: The LinkedIn Content template wrote a full draft from one typed idea after asking what kind of post.

F2.text: Rewrite by chat followed three instructions: under 150 words, unsourced claims removed, question as the call to action.

F3.text: Draft plus rewrite cost 17 credits (300 to 283); the balance is visible at the top.

F4.text: Clips found one 32-second 9:16 clip (1080x1920) in a 2:25 video; it cost 13 credits to get.

F5.text: The clip had roughly 70% black bars, no captions in sampled frames, and quiet audio.

F6.text: Clips needs a source of at least 2 minutes; a 1:33 upload was rejected.

F7.text: The raw draft ran about 175 words against a 150-word ask, had unsourced numbers, no hashtags, no call to action and no product mention.

F8.text: Analytics showed sample data and said so.
